key_insight: A proximal-policy-optimization agent can automatically search quantum circuits for approximate quantum state preparation, balancing high fidelity with fewer gates.
engineering_relevance: This offers an automated circuit-design workflow for quantum software and hardware teams needing efficient state-preparation routines as qubit counts grow.
method: Treat state preparation as a quantum architecture search problem.
Use deep reinforcement learning with PPO to append gates step by step.
Recompute fidelity after each added gate and optimize for accuracy plus circuit compactness.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports experiments on 2–5 qubits for Bell, GHZ, W, Dicke, and random target states, reaching approximation errors as low as 10^-14.
watch_item: Results are shown only on small-scale circuits, so scalability and training cost on larger qubit systems remain a concern.
paper_title: Approximate Quantum State Preparation Through Proximal Policy Optimization
